steps.text: 1. The Contributor opens the tour's "Publish" step in the Studio, the "Restricted access" panel.
2. The system shows the access status and the passcode field (it can only be enabled when the tour is Draft, Rejected or Needs changes).
3. The Contributor enters a passcode and taps "Enable restricted access". E1.

exceptions.text: E1. Empty passcode → "Please enter the access code"; contains spaces → "The access code must not contain spaces"; wrong length → "The access code must have 6 to 32 characters" (400).

steps.text: 4. The system (Tour) stores the passcode as a hash (scrypt), increases the passcode version and moves the tour to "Restricted" with a conditional update statement. E2.

exceptions.text: E2. The tour is not in a status that allows enabling → 409; not the author → 403; disabling a tour that is not restricted → 409.

steps.text: 5. The system shows "Restricted access enabled", the number of testers who have unlocked it and the /tour/:id/unlock link to copy. A1, A3, A4.

exceptions.text: E6. Submitting for review or publishing while the tour is restricted → 409 "… please turn off this mode before submitting for review".

steps.text: 6. The Contributor sends the link and passcode to the test group.
7. The tester opens /tour/:id/unlock (signing in first if not signed in).
8. The system checks whether the tester has already unlocked it. A2.
9. The tester enters the passcode and taps "Unlock".
10. The system records the attempt, counts failures in 15 minutes, compares the hash and stores access by passcode version. E3, E4.

exceptions.text: E4. 5 failures in 15 minutes → 429 "You have entered a wrong code too many times, please try again in 15 minutes", even when the code is right.

steps.text: 11. The system opens the tour page with the "Trial version (restricted access)" label; the tester listens to the tour as in UC#04. E5, A5.

exceptions.text: E5. The tour is no longer restricted or the code has changed → 404; back to the code entry page "The access code has changed…".

steps: A1.1. The Contributor chooses "Change access code", enters a new code and taps "Save new code".
A1.2. The system increases the version and deletes all old access; testers must enter the new code.
A1.3. The Contributor chooses "Disable restricted access" and confirms "Disable access".
A1.4. The system moves the tour back to Draft and deletes the access records and attempts.
A2. The tester has already unlocked with the current passcode version (or is the author) → goes straight to the trial version.
A3. Edit the tour content while restricted: the tour stays "Restricted" and testers see the new content.
A4. To make it public: the Contributor disables restricted access (A1.3), then submits for review (UC#15).
A5. Offline download: the tester downloads the trial version to the device as in UC#03; the download is not counted in the statistics.
